name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. The FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already available in the environment. The OpenAI Python SDK was already installed. I created the quickstart script exactly as documented using the OpenAI-compatible approach. The model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` specified in the docs returned a 404 (model not found), so I listed available models via the API and switched to `accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k3`, which successfully returned a chat completion: "¡Hola! 👋" with additional Spanish greeting variations.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 Not Found error. I had to call the models list endpoint to discover available models and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k3` to complete the quickstart. All other steps (OpenAI SDK usage, base_url, API key from env var, message format) followed the docs exactly.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-9c78f7a69a0e4c8daef3b154a802075c'}

friction.detail: The script using `model = "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1"` from the docs immediately 404s: `openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...`
Attempting `model = "accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct"` yields the same `NOT_FOUND` error, forcing further trial-and-error.
The 404 response `{'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND'}` never hints to list models or which IDs are valid.
With no docs fallback, the user must write a separate `models = client.models.list()` script to discover that `accounts/fireworks/models/kimi-k3` works.
